title: [$175] Member Security - UI does not reflect that the unlock request was submitted.
body:
If you haven’t already, check out our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/Expensify/ReactNativeChat/blob/main/contributingGuides/CONTRIBUTING.md) for onboarding. To join our Slack channel, fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/Q7hnhUJPnQCK7Fe56). ___ **Version Number:** v9.5.0-0 **Reproducible in staging?:** Yes **Reproducible in production?:** Yes **If this was caught during regression testing, add the test name, ID and link from BrowserStack:** https://test-management.browserstack.com/projects/2219752/folder/53678307/test-cases/94420076 **Email or phone of affected tester (no customers):** nchandekar@applausemail.com **Issue reported by:** Applause Internal Team **Bug source:** Regression TC Execution **Device used:** iOS , Windows 11, Android **App Component:** Other ## Action Performed: Preconditions 1.Sign into NewDot as a domain admin. (use admin@expplause.com account) 2.Add a new member to test this scenario and don't lock any existing members Steps: 1. Navigate to Workspace > Domains [Your Domain] > Domain Members and click on a member row 2. Click Report suspicious activity 3. Review the warning message and Verify it states: "Are you sure? This will lock [email]'s account..." 4. Click the red Report suspicious activity button at the bottom 5. Click Lock account to confirm 6. Click Unlock account 7. Click Got it ## Expected Result: The modal closes and the UI reflects that the unlock request has been submitted ## Actual Result: UI does not reflect that the unlock request was submitted. ## Workaround: Unknown ## Platforms: - [x] Android: App - [ ] Android: mWeb Chrome - [x] iOS: App - [ ] iOS: mWeb Safari - [ ] iOS: mWeb Chrome - [x] Windows: Chrome - [ ] MacOS: Chrome Safari ## Screenshots/Videos https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2d8edd84-6f8b-4c23-aaa1-1dfb9185695f [View all open jobs on GitHub](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22Help+Wanted%22) > **Applause Internal Information** > Exported by: Julia Ponikarchuk > Bug ID: 7272332
